mapper.select: SELECT count(1) FROM (SELECT A.BOOKSET_ID, MIN(A.BOOK_DATE) BOOK_DATE FROM BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING A INNER JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_DATE B ON A.BOOKSET_ID = B.BOOKSET_ID AND B.BOOKSET_DATE > A.BOOK_DATE WHERE A.IS_ACCOUNTED='N' GROUP BY A.BOOKSET_ID )TEMP LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET C ON C.BOOKSET_ID = TEMP.BOOKSET_ID

SELECT TEMP.BOOKSET_ID AS bookSetId, C.BOOKSET_NAME AS bookSetName, TO_CHAR(TEMP.BOOK_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') AS bookDate, C.BOOKSET_NAME ||':发生'||TO_CHAR(TEMP.BOOK_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd')||'日交易，请修改会计日期，重新登账！' as reminder FROM (SELECT A.BOOKSET_ID, MIN(A.BOOK_DATE) BOOK_DATE FROM BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING A INNER JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_DATE B ON A.BOOKSET_ID = B.BOOKSET_ID AND B.BOOKSET_DATE > A.BOOK_DATE WHERE A.IS_ACCOUNTED='N' GROUP BY A.BOOKSET_ID )TEMP LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET C ON C.BOOKSET_ID = TEMP.BOOKSET_ID
